text:
Which substances do not produce water as a product when they are reacted together?
A
calcium hydroxide and ammonium chloride
B
calcium carbonate and dilute hydrochloric acid
C
copper(II) oxide and dilute nitric acid
D
zinc and dilute sulfuric acid

options.label: B
options.text: calcium carbonate and dilute hydrochloric acid

options.label: C
options.text: copper(II) oxide and dilute nitric acid
